from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/f67b1f5414e5c9a9fad69312f4acd72c-data.json")
with input_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

print("Loaded input JSON.")
print("schema_version:", data.get("schema_version"))
print("figure_kind:", data.get("figure_kind"))
print("language:", data.get("language"))
print("top-level keys:", list(data.keys()))
# Inspect the complete input structure and basic dimensions before independent calculation.
print(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager
from PIL import Image
from fractions import Fraction

# ---------- Independent numerical calculation ----------
values = data["values"]
if data["figure_kind"] != "scatter" or len(data["variables"]) != 2:
    raise ValueError("Input is not the required two-variable scatter format.")

pairs = []
for row in values:
    if not isinstance(row, list) or len(row) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Each scatter observation must contain exactly two values.")
    x, y = row
    if isinstance(x, bool) or isinstance(y, bool):
        raise ValueError("Boolean values are not valid numerical observations here.")
    x, y = float(x), float(y)
    if not (math.isfinite(x) and math.isfinite(y)):
        raise ValueError("All plotted values must be finite.")
    pairs.append((x, y))

n = len(pairs)
if n < 2:
    coefficient = None
else:
    xs = [p[0] for p in pairs]
    ys = [p[1] for p in pairs]
    mx = math.fsum(xs) / n
    my = math.fsum(ys) / n
    sxx = math.fsum((x - mx) ** 2 for x in xs)
    syy = math.fsum((y - my) ** 2 for y in ys)
    sxy = math.fsum((x - mx) * (y - my) for x, y in pairs)
    coefficient = None if sxx == 0 or syy == 0 else sxy / math.sqrt(sxx * syy)
    if coefficient is not None and not math.isfinite(coefficient):
        coefficient = None

print(f"Independent Pearson result: n={n}, r={coefficient}")

# ---------- Font inspection ----------
required_text = " ".join([
    data["labels"]["title"], data["labels"]["x_label"], data["labels"]["y_label"],
    data["labels"]["caption"],
    *[v.get("name", "") + " " + v.get("unit", "") for v in data["variables"]],
    *[a["term"] + " " + a["definition"] for a in data["presentation"]["abbreviations"]],
])
font_candidates = ["DejaVu Sans", "Liberation Sans", "Noto Sans", "Arial"]
font_name = None
for candidate in font_candidates:
    try:
        path = font_manager.findfont(candidate, fallback_to_default=False)
        if path and os.path.exists(path):
            font_name = candidate
            break
    except Exception:
        pass
if font_name is None:
    font_name = font_manager.FontProperties().get_name()

matplotlib.rcParams["font.family"] = font_name
matplotlib.rcParams["font.size"] = data["plot_config"]["style"]["font_size"]
if "text.parse_math" in matplotlib.rcParams:
    matplotlib.rcParams["text.parse_math"] = False
matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False

# ---------- Exact-canvas plotting ----------
style = data["plot_config"]["style"]
width_px, height_px = int(style["width"]), int(style["height"])
dpi = 300

# Regions are deliberately separate: title, computed summary, axes, x label, caption, abbreviations.
ax = fig.add_axes([0.105, 0.43, 0.86, 0.40], facecolor="white")

palette_name = style.get("palette")
# First color of the standard colorblind-friendly palette.
point_color = "#0173B2" if palette_name == "colorblind" else "#1f77b4"

ax.scatter(
    [p[0] for p in pairs], [p[1] for p in pairs],
    s=54, color=point_color, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.95, zorder=3
)
ax.grid(True, color="#D9D9D9", linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.8, zorder=0)
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color("#555555")
    spine.set_linewidth(0.8)

# Add modest padding without changing tick-value meaning.
xmin, xmax = min(xs), max(xs)
ymin, ymax = min(ys), max(ys)
xpad = (xmax - xmin) * 0.08 if xmax != xmin else max(abs(xmin) * 0.08, 0.5)
ypad = (ymax - ymin) * 0.08 if ymax != ymin else max(abs(ymin) * 0.08, 0.5)
ax.set_xlim(xmin - xpad, xmax + xpad)
ax.set_ylim(ymin - ypad, ymax + ypad)

labels = data["labels"]
presentation = data["presentation"]
x_axis_label = presentation["axes"]["x"]["label"]
y_axis_label = presentation["axes"]["y"]["label"]

ax.set_xlabel(x_axis_label, labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel(y_axis_label, labelpad=10)
fig.suptitle(labels["title"], x=0.535, y=0.965, fontsize=15, fontweight="bold")
summary = f"n = {n}; r = {coefficient:.3f}" if coefficient is not None else f"n = {n}; r = null"
fig.text(0.535, 0.885, summary, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12, color="#222222")

# Wrap by measured character budget appropriate to this exact canvas.
caption_wrapped = textwrap.fill(
    labels["caption"], width=116, break_long_words=False, break_on_hyphens=False
)
abbr_lines = [
    f'{item["term"]}: {item["definition"]}'
    for item in presentation["abbreviations"]
]
abbreviations_text = textwrap.fill(

caption_artist = fig.text(
    0.105, 0.275, caption_wrapped, ha="left", va="top",
    fontsize=10.2, linespacing=1.22, color="#222222"
)
abbr_artist = fig.text(

    fontsize=9.5, linespacing=1.18, color="#333333"

# Draw and inspect all required text bounding boxes.
fig.canvas.draw()
renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
canvas_bbox = fig.bbox
required_artists = [fig._suptitle, ax.xaxis.label, ax.yaxis.label, caption_artist, abbr_artist]
for artist in required_artists:
    bbox = artist.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer)
    if bbox.x0 < -1 or bbox.y0 < -1 or bbox.x1 > canvas_bbox.width + 1 or bbox.y1 > canvas_bbox.height + 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Required text is outside the canvas: {artist.get_text()[:40]}")

# Confirm caption and abbreviations do not overlap each other or the x-axis label.

abbr_box = abbr_artist.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer)
xlabel_box = ax.xaxis.label.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer)
def overlaps(a, b, pad=4):
    return not (a.x1 + pad < b.x0 or b.x1 + pad < a.x0 or a.y1 + pad < b.y0 or b.y1 + pad < a.y0)
if overlaps(cap_box, abbr_box) or overlaps(cap_box, xlabel_box):
    raise RuntimeError("Caption/abbreviation/x-label layout overlap detected.")

figure_path = Path("/mnt/data/figure.png")
fig.savefig(figure_path, dpi=dpi, facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
plt.close(fig)

# Verify exact pixel dimensions.
with Image.open(figure_path) as im:
    if im.size != (width_px, height_px):

    print("Saved figure:", figure_path, "dimensions:", im.size)

# ---------- Strict result JSON ----------

    "schema_version": 5,
    "figure_kind": data["figure_kind"],
    "language": data["language"],
    "plot_config": data["plot_config"],
    "title": labels["title"],

def assert_finite_json(obj):
